Scientist.description: A researcher, student or technician in the lab. A first name alone is not an identity.

Instrument.description: A shared instrument in the core facility, known by its name.

Advising.description:
Who supervises or examines a researcher's degree work.
Running someone's samples does not make you their supervisor.

InstrumentRole.description: A standing role a scientist holds on an instrument: its custodian, or a user signed off to run it alone.

Run.description: A booked run of samples on an instrument. requested_by wants the data, operator runs the instrument, analyst works up the results. A wish to run is not a booking.

SafetyIncident.description: A safety problem in the lab. reported_by raised it, responder deals with it. resolved stays empty until a fix is recorded.

questions.q: Who is the custodian of the Orbitrap?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Instrument)-[:custodian]->(n1:Scientist) WHERE n0.name = 'Orbitrap' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Scientist)-[:examiner]->(n1:Scientist) WHERE n0.name = 'Hae-won Park' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: rafaela_m
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scientist)-[:supervisor]->(n1:Scientist) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: thandiwe
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scientist)-[:student]->(n1:Scientist) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which instruments are in my custody?
questions.speaker: gunnar
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scientist)-[:custody]->(n1:Instrument) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is a trained user of the Krios?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Instrument)-[:trained_user]->(n1:Scientist) WHERE n0.name = 'Krios' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Has the broken fume hood sash been resolved?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:SafetyIncident) WHERE n0.incident = 'broken fume hood sash' RETURN n0.resolved AS resolved

questions.q: Is there a record of the leaking cartridge port being resolved?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:SafetyIncident) WHERE n0.incident = 'leaking cartridge port' RETURN coalesce(n0.resolved, false) AS resolved

questions.q: Who reported the incident in the cold room?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:SafetyIncident)-[:reported_by]->(n1:Scientist) WHERE n0.location = 'cold room' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which runs did Rafaela Duarte request?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scientist)<-[:requested_by]-(n1:Run) WHERE n0.name = 'Rafaela Duarte' RETURN n1.sample AS sample

questions.q: How many hours did the yeast lysates take?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Run) WHERE n0.sample = 'yeast lysates' RETURN n0.hours AS hours

questions.q: What samples and hours were run on the Krios?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Instrument)<-[:instrument]-(n1:Run) WHERE n0.name = 'Krios' RETURN n1.sample AS sample, n1.hours AS hours

questions.q: What state are the grids runs in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Run) WHERE n0.sample CONTAINS 'grids' RETURN n0.state AS state

questions.q: Were the spike protein grids contaminated?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Run) WHERE n0.sample = 'spike protein grids' RETURN n0.contaminated AS contaminated

questions.q: Is there a record that the cardiac tissue was contaminated?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Run) WHERE n0.sample = 'cardiac tissue' RETURN coalesce(n0.contaminated, false) AS contaminated

questions.q: Which incidents did Thandiwe Mokoena report?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Scientist)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:SafetyIncident) WHERE n0.name = 'Thandiwe Mokoena' RETURN n1.incident AS incident
